title: pretty KAIA|Plus Size Knotted Knit Cap Sleeve Maxi Glitter Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
If you want a plus size formal dress that gives shape without squeezing, this one works. The V-neck wrap front sits well on a fuller bust. Sequin cap sleeves cover the top of the arms and keep the look dressy. The ruched twist waist is the main win?ait pulls in the waist and softens the belly area instead of highlighting it. The long skirt skims over hips and thighs, and the sequin insert adds movement when you walk.

Best For

  • Plus size formal wedding guest dresses

  • Black-tie optional events

  • Gala and evening receptions

  • Tummy-friendly fit + defined waist

  • Bust-friendly neckline + subtle arm coverage


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Cap sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises knit.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
